name: google-protobuf
notes: Official Google.Protobuf runtime (NuGet) with protoc --csharp_out generated code.

json_encode = JsonFormatter.Default.Format(msg); json_decode = JsonParser.Default.Parse<T>(string). The output is canonical ProtoJSON but not compact: JsonFormatter.Default emits a space after ':' and ',', so json_encode writes about 10% more bytes than the compact fixture (141/9035/1979535 vs 126/8283/1750634 for small/medium/large). JsonFormatter/JsonParser are reflection-based (descriptor + IFieldAccessor); Google.Protobuf offers no generated JSON code.
Built with dotnet build -c Release, workstation (non-server) GC, default TieredPGO, InvariantGlobalization. TargetFramework net8.0 with RollForward=Major so a newer runtime can execute it.
